keyFindings.description: Round-1 finding 5 remains on the restore and adopt paths: recoverRegisteredInterests (pi) and the remembered/adopted topics (claude) follow every stored topic without streamDeliversNothing, and registrationInput filters only private topics. A topic followed on an earlier build (the base expanded notifications.team.> to the bare notifications.team unconditionally; old skill text invited ad-hoc topics) is sent on every registration and the listener refuses the whole registration 400, for good: the row lapses, role claims fail, a restart restores the topic. Put one filter in envoy-client used by both registration builders (drop uncaptured as well as private), or have the listener drop such a topic with a warning.

PlanInterest puts the stored row's topics into plan.Topics; UpsertPlanned reads the row again and merges plan.Topics back in, then puts unconditionally. An unsubscribe landing between plan and write (the window spans consumers.register: StreamID and Ensure, up to 5 s each) is undone; the row only grows afterward. Reproduced by both reviews on a real NATS. The likeliest trigger is endRole's fire-and-forget Slack unsubscribe racing the next heartbeat. Carry the row's revision in the plan and write with CAS, replanning on conflict.

The load test still subscribes each session's agent subject and issue topics over core NATS and counts those core copies as receipts for any session not relayed, so a session whose registration was refused is credited with deliveries no plugin gets. Delete the core subscriptions, the core handler branch, coreCopy, and take receipts from relay frames only.

The register-through-the-relay sequence (no-relay error, inboundOutage, setFollowed, subscribe, takeDeliveryAnswer) and the uncaptured-topic tool refusal (:3616-3636 / :1380-1396) are copied in both plugins; one envoy-client helper, which also closes important 1.
Regex-parses contracts TypeScript; contracts/scripts/gen-go.ts already emits Go constants — emit the notice prefix and controller token form and delete the hand copies.
Called 'every case of the listener's own table' but is a hand copy with two rows (team exception lane) Go's stored_test.go lacks; add them to Go or share a fixture.

ServingPortSubscribeInput adds nothing (port is already number) and port > 0 is not enforced; envoy-plugin sends port() ?? 0, a portless consumer registration before its serve port resolves. Delete the alias, un-export the parser, and skip or refuse the call while the port is unknown; fix the census row.
StartRequestStoredTo only calls startForward; fold them.
